decided: When the AI would run an external review or a blind pair on its own but your work is not committed yet, it stops and tells you the work is uncommitted, rather than committing the work for you; committing first is left to the stage's next change.
alternatives: have orbit itself check for uncommitted work and give that its own reason to stop
commit the work automatically before running the review
why: Stopping and saying why keeps this change small and never does anything you did not ask for; having orbit check the work itself would break the rule that orbit never reads git state, and committing for you is new behaviour nobody has reviewed yet.
detail: Option A of the fresh system pass's dirty-tree finding (review-system-2026-11-09T23-04-10Z), ratified in chat 2026-11-09: 'c feels right to me. ok to do a first to keep things moving'. Option C (a commit of named paths before a chained external command) is carried to the stage's second change.
